Translate this English consumer-device guide into French. Apply all requirements.

[Source]
Open Settings. Do not disconnect the device during the battery update. Keep APP_ID available.

[Constraints]
1. [Hard Constraint] Terminology mapping: Settings -> Paramètres, APP_ID -> APP_ID
2. [Hard Constraint] Preserve the prohibition against disconnecting the device during the update.
3. [Note] Genre: consumer-device guide for first-time adult users in France. Prefer concise, direct instructions.
4. [Note] Approved owner clarification for this passage: battery update means the battery-management firmware update, not charging.

Return only the French translation.
